p: glory and for beauty: By which his office may be known to be glorious and excellent.
consecrate him: Which is to separate him from the rest.
ephod: A short an straight coat without sleeves, put on top of his garments to keep them close to him.
curious girdle of the ephod: Which went about his upmost coat.
their birth: As they were in age, so should they be graven in order.
memorial unto the children of Israel: That Aaron might remind the Israelites of God.
at the ends: Of the bosses.
judgment with cunning work: It was so called, because the high priest could not give sentence in judgment without that on his breast.
Foursquare it shall be being doubled: The description of the breastplate.
the two ends of the breastplate: Which are upmost toward the shoulder.
two ends of the breastplate in: Which are beneath.
Aaron will not enter into the holy place in his own name, but in the name of all the children of Israel.

Urim and the Thummim: Urim signifies light, and thummim perfection: declaring that the stones of the breastplate were most clear, and of perfect beauty: by urim also is meant knowledge, and thummim holiness, showing what virtues are required in the priests.
HOLINESS TO THE LORD: Holiness belongs to the Lord: for he is most holy, and nothing unholy may appear before him.
bear the iniquity of the holy: Their offerings could not be so perfect, but some fault would be in them: which sin the high priest bore and pacified God.
consecrate them: Or "fill their hands", by giving them things to offer and therefore admit them to their office.
bear not iniquity: In not hiding their nakedness.
